---
title: "Resources"
---

The publications, open datasets, and software behind the \acr{OPDI} — together with the open-source ecosystem the initiative is built upon.

## References of the algorithms {#algorithm-references}

The published work, standards, software and data that the
[OPDI Algorithms](algorithms/index.qmd) pages name under **Based on**. Each page
says how its method relates to them: taken from a source, derived in part
from it, or comparable to it but developed separately.

**Standards and EUROCONTROL methods**

- []{#ref-acdm-manual}EUROCONTROL (2017). *Airport Collaborative
  Decision-Making (A-CDM) Implementation Manual*, version 5.0, 31 March 2017.
  [Publication page](https://www.eurocontrol.int/publication/airport-collaborative-decision-making-cdm-implementation-manual).
  Defines the 16 A-CDM milestones, among them landing (`ALDT`, milestone 6),
  in-block (`AIBT`, 7), off-block (`AOBT`, 15) and take-off (`ATOT`, 16),
  and the taxi-out and taxi-in times.
- []{#ref-ganp-kpi}ICAO. *GANP Portal: KPI overview* (the key performance
  indicators of the Global Air Navigation Plan).
  [PDF](https://www4.icao.int/ganpportal/ASBU/KPI/Pdf). Among them KPI02
  (taxi-out additional time), KPI05 (actual en-route extension), KPI08
  (additional time in terminal airspace, with 40 NM and 100 NM cylinders),
  KPI13 (taxi-in additional time), KPI17 (level-off during climb) and KPI19
  (level-off during descent).
- []{#ref-pru-vfe}Peeters, S., and Guastalla, G. (2017). *Analysis of
  vertical flight efficiency during climb and descent*. EUROCONTROL
  Performance Review Unit, edition 00-04, 19 January 2017.
  [PDF](https://ansperformance.eu/references/library/vertical-flight-efficiency-during-climb-and-descent_consultation.pdf).
- []{#ref-point-merge}EUROCONTROL. *Point Merge* (concept page, with the
  reference documents of the method).
  [Web page](https://www.eurocontrol.int/concept/point-merge).
- []{#ref-pms-catalogue}EUROCONTROL (2026). *Point Merge catalogue: an
  inventory of worldwide implementations*, July 2026.
  [Publication page](https://www.eurocontrol.int/publication/point-merge-catalogue).
- []{#ref-airnav-enr15}AirNav Ireland. *Irish AIP, ENR 1.5 Holding, approach
  and departure procedures* (AIRAC 14 May 2026). States that holding
  procedures are based on ICAO Doc 8168 (PANS-OPS), Volume II.
  [Web page](https://www.airnav.ie/AIRAC_MAY_2026/2026-05-14-AIRAC/html/eAIP/EI-ENR-1.5-en-IE.html).

**Papers and reports**

- []{#ref-olive-2019}Olive, X. (2019). traffic, a toolbox for processing and
  analysing air traffic data. *Journal of Open Source Software*, 4(39),
  1518. [doi:10.21105/joss.01518](https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.01518).
  Software: [documentation](https://traffic-viz.github.io/),
  [source code](https://github.com/xoolive/traffic).
- []{#ref-olive-2024}Olive, X., Basora, L., Sun, J., and Spinielli, E.
  (2024). Training a machine learning model to detect holding patterns in
  aircraft trajectories. *Journal of Open Aviation Science*, 2(2).
  [doi:10.59490/joas.2024.7943](https://doi.org/10.59490/joas.2024.7943).
- []{#ref-olive-2025}Olive, X., Waltert, M., and Schultz, M. (2025).
  Assessing airport surface traffic performance from open sources of
  aviation data. *Air Transportation Research and Development Symposium*.
  [Publication page](https://www.unibw.de/lvk-en/publications/2025_zhr_surface).
- []{#ref-proud-2020}Proud, S. R. (2020). Go-around detection using
  crowd-sourced ADS-B position data. *Aerospace*, 7(2), 16.
  [doi:10.3390/aerospace7020016](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace7020016).
- []{#ref-quiver-2025}Team resourceful-quiver, Delft University of Technology
  (2025). *Fuel consumption estimation*. Report of the winning solution of
  the PRC Data Challenge 2025.
  [Repository with the report](https://github.com/PRC-Data-Challenge-2025/resourceful-quiver).
- []{#ref-schafer-2014}Schäfer, M., Strohmeier, M., Lenders, V., Martinovic,
  I., and Wilhelm, M. (2014). Bringing up OpenSky: a large-scale ADS-B sensor
  network for research. *Proceedings of the 13th International Symposium on
  Information Processing in Sensor Networks (IPSN)*, 83–94.
  [doi:10.1109/IPSN.2014.6846743](https://doi.org/10.1109/IPSN.2014.6846743).
- []{#ref-schultz-2022}Schultz, M., Rosenow, J., and Olive, X. (2022).
  Data-driven airport management enabled by operational milestones derived
  from ADS-B messages. *Journal of Air Transport Management*, 99, 102164.
  [doi:10.1016/j.jairtraman.2021.102164](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jairtraman.2021.102164).
- []{#ref-sun-2017}Sun, J., Ellerbroek, J., and Hoekstra, J. (2017). Flight
  extraction and phase identification for large automatic dependent
  surveillance–broadcast datasets. *Journal of Aerospace Information
  Systems*, 14(10), 566–572.
  [doi:10.2514/1.I010520](https://doi.org/10.2514/1.I010520).
- []{#ref-sun-2020}Sun, J., Hoekstra, J. M., and Ellerbroek, J. (2020).
  OpenAP: an open-source aircraft performance model for air transportation
  studies and simulations. *Aerospace*, 7(8), 104.
  [doi:10.3390/aerospace7080104](https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace7080104).
  Software: [OpenAP](https://openap.dev/).

**Software and data**

- []{#ref-likable-jelly}Alligier, R., and Gianazza, D. (2024). *Team
  likable_jelly*, winning solution of the PRC Data Challenge 2024 (ENAC).
  [Repository](https://github.com/PRC-Data-Challenge-2024/team_likable_jelly).
- []{#ref-hexaeropy}Goens, Q. (2024). *HexAeroPy*, a EUROCONTROL Python
  package that finds the airports, runways, taxiways and stands used by a
  flight from its positions, version 1.0.4.
  [Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/HexAeroPy),
  [package](https://pypi.org/project/HexAeroPy/),
  [data (doi:10.5281/zenodo.10651018)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10651018).
- []{#ref-h3}Uber. *H3: a hexagonal hierarchical geospatial indexing system*.
  [Documentation](https://h3geo.org/).
- []{#ref-olive-data-2022}Olive, X., Basora, L., and Sun, J. (2022). *Arrival
  trajectories at five major European airports*. 4TU.ResearchData, version 1.
  [doi:10.4121/20411868.v1](https://doi.org/10.4121/20411868.v1).
- []{#ref-opensky-api}The OpenSky Network. *OpenSky REST API*: the fields and
  units of a state vector.
  [Documentation](https://openskynetwork.github.io/opensky-api/rest.html).
- []{#ref-osm-aeroway}OpenStreetMap Wiki. *Key:aeroway*: the tags of airport
  areas such as runways, taxiways, aprons and stands.
  [Wiki page](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:aeroway).
- []{#ref-ourairports}OurAirports. *Open data downloads* (airports and
  runways, public domain, updated daily).
  [Repository](https://github.com/davidmegginson/ourairports-data).
- []{#ref-pruatlas}EUROCONTROL Performance Review Unit. *pruatlas*: maps and
  boundaries for PRU publications, including the flight information regions
  of the Network Manager.
  [Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/pruatlas).

## OPDI Software

Open-source projects created and maintained by the \acr{PRC} as part of the initiative.

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang}

**[OPDI](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi)**

The software that produces the OPDI data: a Python package that runs the
processing steps on Apache Spark, from the OpenSky Network's position reports
to the published daily files. [Processing steps](algorithms/processing-steps.qmd)
describes what it does, and the [OPDI Algorithms](algorithms/index.qmd) pages describe
each algorithm.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} API reference](https://euctrl-pru.github.io/OPDI/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang}

**OPDI reader (`opdi.published`)**

A small part of the OPDI package that reads the published daily files into
pandas tables, gives back the table shapes of release v0.0.2, and creates
DuckDB views. It needs pandas, pyarrow and DuckDB, not Spark. See
[Data Access](data/access.qmd#python) for examples.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Airflow]{.pill .pill-lang}

**OPDI daily processing (Airflow)**

The schedule that produces the data: two Apache Airflow workflows, one that
processes each new day and one that processes a chosen range of past days.
They are in the `airflow/` folder of the OPDI repository, with instructions
for running them.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang}

**[HexAeroPy](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/HexAeroPy)**

Determines the airports, runways, taxiways, and stands used by a flight from its coordinates alone. Developed for small-scale applications of the OPDI approach to airport layouts.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/HexAeroPy)
:::
::::

## Open-Source Foundations

Open-source projects from the wider open aviation software community that
OPDI builds on, or that work well with its data.

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [MIT]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[traffic](https://traffic-viz.github.io/)**

A toolbox for processing and analysing air traffic data, for example to plot
and analyse the trajectories of OPDI flights.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/xoolive/traffic) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://traffic-viz.github.io/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[OpenAP](https://openap.dev/)**

The open model for aircraft performance and emissions, by [Dr. Junzi Sun](https://junzis.com/) of TU Delft. OPDI uses its rules and values to decide the flight phase of each position report (see [Vertical events](algorithms/tops.qmd)).

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/junzis/openap) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://openap.dev/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[pyopensky](https://mode-s.org/pyopensky/)**

The Python interface to the \acr{OSN} database, providing access to state vectors and historical trajectories via the REST API and Trino.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/open-aviation/pyopensky) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://mode-s.org/pyopensky/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[fastmeteo](https://github.com/open-aviation/fastmeteo)**

A fast tool for obtaining meteorological data along flight trajectories, for example to add weather to OPDI flights.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/open-aviation/fastmeteo)
:::
::::

## Contributing

If you maintain an open-source project that builds on OPDI data, or would like to contribute to one of ours, we would like to hear from you. Contact us at [pru-support@eurocontrol.int](mailto:pru-support@eurocontrol.int).
